name: slider
useFor: Use to set an amount within a range where the exact figure matters less than its size (a daily limit, a share of a budget). Show the current value beside it, give it an aria-label or a Label, and pass two values for a range.
constraints: A slider for an exact amount someone must type (use a field)
source: Extrapolated from the brand's switch and tab track (agentcard-website src/app/globals.css .plan-tabs, --bevel)
title: Slider
description: A sunken track filled with the blue key up to the value, with the switch's white key riding on it.
